description:
A House Built in Just One Day?! From Robot-Built Homes to Traditional Korean Houses

Hello, this is King Process.
How are houses built in Korea?
In this video, we introduce three different house-building processes: modular homes whose frames are completed in just one day by dozens of robots, dome houses assembled like Lego blocks using panels made by inflating special plastic, and beautiful traditional Korean houses carefully built by skilled carpenters.
See Korea’s different house-building techniques in one video, from robotic automation systems that cut lumber and assemble walls according to design plans, to blow molding high-density polyethylene into strong panels, and traditional carpentry that shapes and joins wood to complete a traditional Korean house.
